privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Synqer, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our event scheduling service.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.description: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
items: Account information (name, email address, profile picture) from your Google or LINE account
Event data (event names, descriptions, time slots, voting preferences)
Calendar information when you connect your Google Calendar
LINE group membership data when you use LINE integration features

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.description: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
Process your event scheduling and voting activities
Sync with your calendar to show availability conflicts
Send notifications about events you're participating in
Communicate with you about service updates

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.description: We integrate with the following third-party services:
items: Google (for authentication and calendar integration)
LINE (for authentication and group messaging features)
These services have their own privacy policies governing their use of your data

security.title: Data Security
security.description: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. All data transmission is encrypted using SSL/TLS. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

rights.title: Your Rights
items: Access the personal information we hold about you
Request correction of inaccurate data
Request deletion of your account and associated data
Disconnect third-party service integrations at any time

updates.title: Policy Updates
updates.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
